Bug_Title: ICAST: int value converted to long and used as absolute time (ICAST_INT_2_LONG_AS_INSTANT)
Bug_Explanation: The code converts a 32-bit int value to a 64-bit long value after performing multiplication using 32-bit arithmetic. This results in incorrect representation of time as the multiplication overflows before conversion, leading to an incorrect absolute time value.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test triggers the bug by passing a large int value to the showBug method, causing an incorrect conversion to a long due to 32-bit integer overflow before conversion. This results in an invalid absolute time value used to create a Date object, which the test expects to be null, causing the test to fail.
